$comment: Known answers for perf/stats.mjs on aggregate-reference.jsonl. median/p95/min/max/mean are derived by hand (linear-interpolation percentiles: 1..100 -> median 50.5, p95 at index 0.95*(n-1) = 94.05 -> 95 + 0.05*(96-95) = 95.05). median_ci95 is the seeded (seed 1, 2000 resamples) percentile bootstrap, recorded from the first implementation; the constant dataset must collapse to [42,42] and the five-point set must span its range.
